questions.question: Which dimension should softmax normalize for one query to combine all key/value pairs?
questions.explanation: One query needs a probability distribution across keys; each row must sum to one.
optionFeedback: Normalizing over queries changes which probabilities sum to one. For each query, sum its weights over the available keys.
One query needs a probability distribution across keys; each row must sum to one.
The value-feature axis belongs to the weighted output representation. Attention probabilities normalize over candidate key positions.
